scope: All 76 source task identities, all public grader functions, shared metrics, launch lists, public data catalog and archive manifest inspected. Nine biomedical domains. Provisional ID from the agentic tab.
assessment_scope: Catalog objectives and executable scoring endpoints assessed. Authoritative per-task descriptions, sample submissions and input data remain inside separate archives and have not been inspected. Patterns are endpoint summaries, not claims of full prompt review or execution.
identity_policy: Task IDs agree between all four 19-task launch lists, the 76 grader paths and the public data manifest. Shared datasets, model targets and train/test cohorts are not independent studies.

source_runtime.note: Source scripts configure a two-hour timeout and GPU availability. This is not a measured per-task runtime or a demonstrated CPU requirement.

task_defaults.assessment: Catalog objective and source scorer assessed; full prompt and data uninspected.
